title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 14

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Who should the student ask for at reception?
tasks.audioText: Hello, this is Mr Green from the engineering company. We are expecting you for your work placement on Wednesday at half past eight. Please report to reception and ask for Ms Patel. Wear smart work clothes and bring your college placement form. Your supervisor will show you the work area and explain your daily tasks. If you are delayed, telephone reception before your arrival time.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What should the student do if delayed?
tasks.audioText: Hello, this is Mr Green from the engineering company. We are expecting you for your work placement on Wednesday at half past eight. Please report to reception and ask for Ms Patel. Wear smart work clothes and bring your college placement form. Your supervisor will show you the work area and explain your daily tasks. If you are delayed, telephone reception before your arrival time.

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. During her work placement, Eva keeps a daily log. At the end of each shift, she records the tasks she completed and the equipment she used. When she is unsure about a procedure, she asks her supervisor before continuing. On Friday, she reviews the log and writes down two skills she wants to practise next week. When does Eva update her daily log?
options: At the end of each shift

tasks.prompt: Reading 2. What does Eva do when she is unsure about a procedure?
Choose the correct form: 'Eva ___ her log after every shift.'
Choose TWO professional behaviours during work placement.
options: Hide a mistake from the supervisor.
Ask when a procedure is unclear.
Keep an accurate record of tasks.

tasks.prompt: Complete with one word: 'A person who supervises your work is your ___.'
You need to report a delay. What is the most appropriate message?
options: I am sorry, I am delayed and expect to arrive at 9:00.

tasks.prompt: Put the work-placement routine in the correct order.
options: Record the work in the daily log
correctOrder: Record the work in the daily log

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words about a successful first day of work placement. Describe how to arrive prepared, communicate with a supervisor and record completed tasks.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains how to arrive prepared, communicate with the supervisor and record completed tasks (0–2); these actions are placed in a sensible first-day sequence and include a relevant example of a question or update to the supervisor (0–2); grammar and sentence structure are understandable (0–2); workplace communication/log vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
